properties.name: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(2^h) hash computations, h=63, k=14, w=16, len=35
properties.algebraic_structure: Hypertree constructed from FORS (Forest of Random Subtrees) and XMSS trees using SHA-256

properties.name: SHA-256 Compression Function (Davies-Meyer with Merkle-Damgård Construction)
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: 64 rounds of message expansion & state updates per 512-bit block; Space: 256 bits state
properties.ring_modulus: Arithmetic modulo 2^32 across 8 working variables (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)

properties.name: Intel SHA Extensions (SHA-NI)
properties.throughput_bounds: 2 SIMD rounds per instruction cycle via specialized microarchitectural hardware pipelines

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform 2 rounds of SHA-256 state updates using state from xmm1 and xmm2/m128 and message constants in implicit XMM0
Perform first phase of SHA-256 message schedule expansion on 4 32-bit words in xmm1 using xmm2/m128

properties.operation: Drives WOTS+ public key evaluation and Merkle tree node hashing

properties.vector_width: 128-bit vector processing of 4 parallel 32-bit SHA-256 state/message words

properties.stage: Execution of 2-round iterative state compression loop
Quad-word message schedule W[t] generation step

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 128-bit XMM register holding working state variables (a,b,e,f) and (c,d,g,h)
Read/Write 128-bit XMM register holding 4 message schedule dwords

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 205: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
